lead_raw_text:
The structure of K6Li6Ag3O18 (reduced formula K2Li2AgO6) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 148), with 33 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ag and Li centers each coordinated by 4 O neighbors, while K centers show 9 O neighbors; the O centers adopt tetrahedral environments with mixed Ag, K, and Li coordination. Corner-sharing is observed between tetrahedral O polyhedra, as well as between K 9-vertex polyhedra, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component.
